scope: Selective pure-transform reuse during workflow amendment
before_change: An input snapshot change invalidated every settled node. Transform rows recorded the generic node input bundle, which did not identify the resolved operation arguments.
after_change: Top-level unconditional transforms persist only a SHA-256 digest of resolved arguments. Amendment preview simulates candidate scope using only already-proven reusable results; it preserves a transform only when its digest and dependency results match, and invalidates the changed node plus dependent transforms.

test_results.command: .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q src/hutch/workflow/engine.py src/hutch/workflow/amendments.py tests/test_workflow_api.py && git diff --check

regressions.preview_changed_input: source is inputs_changed; derived is dependency_result_not_reusable; independent is reusable
regressions.adopt_and_resume: source and derived execute a second time; independent executes only once; the new question waits under the amended revision
regressions.storage: the source node input record contains a 64-character resolved_args_sha256 value and does not contain the resolved input string
regressions.map_reordering: keyed map instances remain invalidated when their input order changes
regressions.missing_reference: failed transforms retain their site-specific failure reason

initial_integration_failures: The first broad run exposed changed invalidation reasons for map expansions and a site-less missing-reference error. Both behaviors were restored, then the 79-test combined suite passed.
limitations: Only settled top-level unconditional pure transforms can be reused. Nested transforms, transforms with conditions, tool/model/evidence results and control/container outputs remain conservative.
Selective affected-branch draining is not implemented; adoption still requires the workflow to be parked and quiet.
The digest adds work proportional to the resolved argument size; no comparative large-document throughput benchmark was run in this slice.
No UI changed in this slice, so no new browser screenshot was captured. Existing Studio amendment visuals and interactions retain their separately linked evidence.

runtime.transport: FastAPI TestClient with local SQLite state; no external requests
